name: peak_frame_wide
prompt:
Redraw the reference picture - a slot-game board frame made of chunky cartoon logs on a fully transparent background - keeping EXACTLY the same frame outline in the same place and at the same size: the same rectangle and proportions, the same thin side logs, the same round log ends at the four corners, the same snow along the top log, and the same completely EMPTY, fully transparent inside (nothing at all drawn inside the frame). Make it higher quality and a little more detailed: bark texture lines and knots in the wood, growth rings on the log ends, the snow on the top log deeper with soft blue shading and a few sparkles, a few more icicles, a small green cannabis leaf and a pinecone with pine sprigs in the top corners. NEW: centred on the top log, in the empty space above it, a big wide wooden SIGN BOARD made of horizontal planks with a thick snow cap on its top edge and a little snow on its ends, standing on the top log on two short wooden posts. The sign board's face is plain light wood and completely BLANK - no text, no letters, no logo, no picture on it (a logo goes on it later). The sign is about 45% of the frame's width, about three times as wide as it is tall, and it never reaches down into the inside of the frame. Everything outside the frame and the sign is fully transparent. Higher quality and a little more detailed than before: crisp clean ink lines, more small texture lines in the snow, rock and wood, more depth layers - but still flat cartoon colours, readable at a glance.

Style: flat 2D adult-animation TV cartoon (late-night animated sitcom look). Thick, even, confident black outlines; flat cel colours with at most one simple hard-edged shadow tone and one small white highlight; bright saturated candy colours; chunky, rounded, slightly goofy proportions; simple readable shapes. NO realistic lighting, NO gradients, NO painterly texture, NO 3D render, NO photo. Clean vector-like finish.
